sloka: एवम् चेत्त्वं सहास्माभिस्तस्याः प्रेष्य भविष्यसि ।पुत्रश्च तव रामस्य प्रेष्यभावं गमिष्यति ॥२-८-११॥
transliteration: evam cettvaṁ sahāsmābhistasyāḥ preṣya bhaviṣyasi ।putraśca tava rāmasya preṣyabhāvaṁ gamiṣyati ॥2-8-11॥

translations.english: If you thus become her attendant along with us, your son will also develop slavishness towards Rama.
